structural_change: ovl_m1 (TW7-KVD2D 10-19): the MU overlap KV master qkd_d2d_static_ovl #(.NTX(3), .TXDP(32'h03030415)) (MU-D2D-OVL 0fc36caf5, generated by tools/qwen_split/d2d_ovl_masters.py) on the r7w/r7v geometry (outline 475.2x280.8, 4 SRAM 2x2 on the lattice, recipe 4 flop-first pins, io_hold_margin 0.030, CTS 20/40, MEG 2.4/1.2) + 6 new pin-registered ports: E cal_start_rx, cal_seg_rx, cal_user_tx[1:0], cal_user_rx[1:0] (y 149.628-150.348 beside cal_start/cal_seg), S tx_user[1:0], rx_user[1:0] (x 144.348-144.636). Each new pin has one PR flop like cal_start, so cal_start_rx/cal_start keep equal latency (0 cycles added to the one-playhead frame); the overlap frame is compiled by tools/qwen_static_schedule/mu_d2d_ovl.py (F16 13,708.2 tok/s vs 9,834.1 one playhead).
